title: Sorry I haven't been posting art lately, my kitten won't let me draw
author: bbystarkoobi
text: sorry I havent been posting art lately my kitten wont let me draw
blurb: The poster apologizes for the lack of new art lately, and here's the culprit: a fluffy tabby kitten parking a big furry paw right on the tablet, mid-sketch. Hard to argue with that kind of supervision.
